verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs explicitly cover release association (Associate Commits, releases product docs) and Suspect Commits, which directly deliver the story of tying issues to the release they first appeared in and identifying likely-cause commits. This is a core, well-documented first-party feature set, though the pack lacks independent hands-on corroboration of the suspect-commit accuracy or a walkthrough of the full commit-to-release workflow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of suspect commit accuracy, deeper docs excerpt on release-issue linkage UI.
